test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b41cb8e0076d0978cc9338cc392a136dc3ddea85022e308017a67328194c08b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) First box alternate series → First row and third column element interchange positions and the rest elements shift in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0392ccffa0e3b7551c8fcebd3658946196b6413436cfd382b4cb82255863b5cd.png] 

2) Second box alternate series → First column and third-row element interchange positions and the rest elements shift in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94315e01475498573e2d93fdbd3c5bea52ca728e8585a492df2a93268517670b.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81259ad927f606198f4cd3329c31c1debca78690e6ea4e6db273f304dd950e66.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdd3a8702204dfab26de6d9e046973b9d8750617f57140d872574ead22f3dc2d.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
